---
name: present
description: Use when the older version directory of a plugin still holds a readable skill and the newer one holds nothing a reader can use.
---

# Present

`1.0.0` is not the resolved version for `ghost-kit`. `2.0.0` is, because the DIRECTORY
`ghost-kit/2.0.0/skills` exists — and it exists whether or not anything under it parses.
